summary: Full frontend verification of the four new Standby/Crossfader enhancements. ALL PASS. (1) Cue-to-Standby: clicking cue-track-1 shows the CUE panel with a visible cue-to-standby-button; clicking it arms track 'b' into the standby deck (standby-track-name='b', standby-bpm rendered). (2) Fader Curve toggle: fader-curve-sharp and fader-curve-smooth correctly gain/lose the 'bg-[var(--hl-cue)]' active class when toggled; verified twice, no crash, works even before/after arming. (3) SYNC button (standby-sync) clicked with track armed — no runtime-error overlay, control stays responsive; standby-bpm element present. Interestingly BPM estimator returned values (128→148) even on sine tones, and sync applied a rate (visible in UI), but that is not a fail condition per the task. (4) Nudge back/fwd both clickable without any volume/playbackRate errors. (5) Keyboard Take '\' with focus on BODY fires TAKE — transition completes ~3s, standby-empty reappears, track-row-1 gains border-[var(--hl-fire)] (now on air). (6) Regression: arming via standby-track-0 still works, jingle-duck-depth and jingle-pad-0 still present, 1920px layout intact. Zero pageerrors, zero runtime-error overlay. Only console noise is the pre-existing (unrelated, LOW) hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> from the visual-editor wrapper around PlayerBar crossfade-seconds <option> elements.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Visual-editor injects a <span style=display:contents> inside each <option>. Console noise only.

action_items: (Optional, carried over) Fix the <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning in PlayerBar crossfade-seconds select.
critical_code_review_comments: audioEngine.setFaderCurve + _faderGains cleanly separates smooth (equal-power cos/sin) vs sharp (dual linear cut) curves. Curve is applied on every setFader/take, good.
syncStandby correctly clamps playback rate to 0.92-1.08 and folds half/double-time BPM ratios before applying; nudgeStandby uses a momentary 260ms bump then restores base rate — reasonable.
Backslash hotkey in App.js correctly ignores keydown when target tag is input/select/textarea and only fires when eng.standbyArmed. Good defensive gating.
CuePanel onArmStandby prop wiring is clean; button only rendered when a cueTrack exists.

Minor: sine-tone WAVs yielded non-null BPMs (128/148) — estimateBpm may benefit from a higher onset threshold to return null for pure tones, but this does not affect correctness (task states this is acceptable).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All four enhancements (Cue-to-Standby, Beat/Auto Sync + Nudge, Fader Curve smooth/sharp, Backslash TAKE hotkey) are verified working end-to-end at desktop 1920x800. Regression (row-arm + drag/take + jingles) intact. Only outstanding console issue remains the pre-existing hydration warning from visual-editor wrappers on PlayerBar crossfade <option> elements — unrelated to Standby.
